explanation: Bangladesh's anthem, Amar Shonar Bangla, 'My Golden Bengal', dates from 1905, when Tagore protested the partition of Bengal. In all he wrote more than 2,000 songs, known as Rabindra Sangeet.

claims.text: Rabindranath Tagore wrote the national anthems of India (Jana Gana Mana) and Bangladesh (Amar Shonar Bangla).
Kazi Nazrul Islam, Muhammad Iqbal and Sarojini Naidu did not write the national anthem of India or of Bangladesh.
Amar Shonar Bangla, meaning My Golden Bengal, was written in 1905, when Tagore protested the partition of Bengal.
Tagore's songs are known in Bengali as Rabindra Sangeet.
